article.title: HeyGen Avatar 6按稿件語境生成動作，既有分身可升級
article.title_en: HeyGen Avatar 6 follows script context, with existing-avatar upgrades
article.summary: HeyGen推出Avatar 6，以語音及稿件內容引導分身的動作與表情，支援原生2K影片。
article.summary_en: HeyGen launched Avatar 6 with audio- and script-led movement and expressions, including native 2K video.
highlights: 既有Personal Avatars可升級，毋須重新錄製素材。
真人逼真影片保留在HeyGen平台，需明確同意及身份核實。
highlights_en: Existing Personal Avatars can upgrade without new recording.
Realistic real-person videos remain on HeyGen with identity verification and explicit consent.
article.why: 講者影片可把動作設計與稿件內容一起審閱，內容團隊可決定哪些語句需要更清楚的手勢或情緒提示。
article.why_en: Content teams can review gestures alongside scripts and choose which lines need clearer motion or emotion cues.
article.next_step: 以一段產品示範稿標記指向、數量及語氣要求，比較分身動作是否對應句意，再修訂不合適的段落。
article.next_step_en: Mark pointing, counting and tone requirements in one product script and compare movement with each line's meaning.
article.detail: 公司表示模型可參照個人素材的動作方式，並依說話語境調整表演。第三方平台的支援仍有範圍區分，不能把照片或虛擬分身接入等同所有真人影片都可外部生成。團隊可先以已取得同意的講者材料建立參考，逐段審閱口形、動作與產品陳述，再由品牌負責人決定哪些版本適合交付。
article.detail_en: HeyGen describes reference-led personal motion and contextual performance. Third-party access has scope limits: photo or virtual avatars do not imply every real-person workflow is available externally. Use consented reference material and review lip sync, motion and product statements before the brand owner approves delivery.
